A visible way to take a picture out of a page

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, tap a picture, then Remove from page, then Undo. **Expect:** the picture goes with the space after it, the photo stays in the Chronicle, "Taken out of the page" and Undo show above the keyboard bar, and Undo puts the picture back where it was (NI19).
